cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I accept your explanation for missing my concert, tell me why I saved that front-row seat for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That warning is acknowledged. Now address why I still looked at the empty seat before every song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You needed someone there who knew what this meant to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That answer is on the right track. You heard me practise for months. Tell me why a stranger sitting there wouldn't have been the same; that's the part I need you to understand.
